name: Hotel
description: Check in, book a room and ask for help.

name: Café
description: Order food and drinks with confidence.

name: School
description: Ask questions and join classroom life.

name: Transport
description: Buy tickets and navigate your journey.

name: Everyday Life
description: Handle everyday errands and requests.

name: Shopping
description: Choose clothes, ask prices and pay.
sample: I would like to try on this jacket.

name: Directions
description: Ask for a place and explain the route.
sample: Excuse me, where is the library?

name: News articles
description: Read a short report and identify its main idea.
sample: La bibliothèque ouvre un nouvel espace pour les enfants samedi.
The library is opening a new space for children on Saturday.

name: Adverts
description: Understand offers, notices and announcements.
sample: Cours de français le samedi. Inscription gratuite !
French classes on Saturdays. Free registration!

name: Interview
description: Introduce yourself and describe your experience.
sample: Je suis une personne organisée et j’aime travailler en équipe.
I am an organized person and I like working in a team.

name: Arguments between friends
description: Disagree respectfully and work things out.
sample: Je comprends, mais je ne suis pas d’accord.

name: Party scene
description: Meet people, chat and enjoy a gathering.
sample: Hi! How do you know our host?

name: Playing in the park
description: Talk about games, play and outdoor activities.

name: Picnic
description: Plan what to bring and share a meal outdoors.
sample: Je peux apporter des fruits et de l’eau.
I can bring fruit and water.

name: Corporate business
description: Join meetings and discuss plans professionally.
sample: Pouvons-nous fixer une réunion pour lundi ?
Can we schedule a meeting for Monday?

name: Customer service
description: Explain an issue and help find a solution.
sample: Bonjour, j’ai un problème avec ma commande.
Hello, I have a problem with my order.

name: Registration
description: Complete forms and ask about requirements.
sample: What documents are needed to register?

name: Wedding
description: Congratulate the couple and join the celebration.
sample: Toutes mes félicitations pour votre mariage !

name: Birthday party
description: Give birthday wishes and talk about the party.
sample: Joyeux anniversaire ! Voici un petit cadeau pour toi.
Happy birthday! Here is a small present for you.

name: Invitation
description: Invite someone, accept or politely decline.
sample: Veux-tu venir dîner chez moi samedi ?
Would you like to come to my home for dinner on Saturday?
